area: south of Highway 46 near Wildwood Road
summary: Grass fire burning three to four acres in a field near a small trailer community just east of Wildwood Road, with roads on three sides. Battalion 3 on scene requested additional wildland units; Engine 931 gained access from the south.

area: northbound highway just south of Twisselman Road
summary: Vehicle rollover reported in the median just south of Twisselman Road, with reports of power lines down across the lane. Units en route.
Person reported coming into a campground wearing a gray t-shirt, gray pants and no shoes; units checking the area.

area: 100 block Sumner Street, near the railroad tracks
